en-UK.name: Beilu Reach
en-UK.description: Platform adapters — AI can search and read Twitter, Bilibili, YouTube, GitHub, Reddit and more.
en-UK.description_markdown: **Beilu Reach** gives the AI structured access to 13 internet platforms via `<reach>` tags. Each platform has dedicated adapters for deep, structured data retrieval beyond generic web scraping.
en-UK.author: 凛倾

zh-CN.name: 平台触达
zh-CN.description: 平台适配器 — AI 可搜索和读取 Twitter、B站、YouTube、GitHub、Reddit 等平台
zh-CN.description_markdown: **平台触达** 通过 `<reach>` 标签让 AI 获取 13 个互联网平台的结构化数据。每个平台有专用适配器，比通用网页抓取更深层。
zh-CN.author: 凛倾
